summary: Access Management > Roles lists roles with component labels and can be sorted or filtered by Name, Editable or Component. Only organization roles can span controller and EDA; Automation Content uses "system" roles that cover all resources of a type.
questions: How do I view all roles in AAP?
Can a role cover both controller and Event-Driven Ansible?
What is a system role in automation hub?
How do I filter roles by component?
